description: Octopus superhero v2 (artist 2026-09-26): ALL BLUE - the whole body (torso, head, neck, arm and leg tentacles) takes the cape's darker royal blue; every tentacle tip (arm, leg, cape) shares the cape's lighter tip blue; an angular swept W-visor with an ORANGE frame and complementing pale-cyan glowing lenses; a small dark siphon hole where the mouth piece was; a gold octopus sigil on the chest; pale periwinkle cape lining; the pale cyan WATER webs (unchanged, approved) with their bright glowing free edge.

skin.note: octopus body: torso, neck, arm and leg tentacles - the cape's darker blue (artist v2: all one blue)

head.note: the mantle (head) - the same blue as the body

arm_tip.note: arm tentacle paddle tips - the cape tips' lighter blue (one tip shade on every tentacle)

leg_tip.note: leg tentacle tips - the cape tips' lighter blue

visor.note: W-visor outer frame - superhero orange (the reference sticker's orange)

lens.note: visor lenses - pale cyan glow, the complement of the orange frame

siphon.note: the siphon hole (replaces the mouth piece) - near-black navy: reads as an opening in the blue

cape.note: cape tentacles - royal blue (the colour the whole body now takes)

cape_under.note: cape tentacle lining (sucker side, faces the body) - pale periwinkle

membrane.note: WATER webs between the cape tentacles - pale cyan, soft inner glow (approved, unchanged)

membrane_rim.note: the webs' free edge - bright water/foam glow
